title: What the county added, line by line
subtitle: New money in the Travis County budget advanced Sept. 10, in millions of dollars
alt: Bar chart of new money added to the Travis County Fiscal Year 2027-28 budget at the September 10 markup: 3 million dollars reserved for outside indigent-defense counsel, 2 million dollars for the Supportive Housing Initiative Pipeline, 1.6 million dollars earmarked for felony case representation, 1.5 million dollars for public defender attorney pay, and 1 million dollars a year for the Travis County Transformation Project
source: Travis County budget markup, via Community Impact
